ideas.pitch: A predictive debugging suite that forecasts recurring production crash spikes and isolates root-cause anomalies before deployments break.
ideas.title: BugTrail: Automated Incident Forecasting & Triage Engine
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact pattern of hard engineering and rigorous data modeling seen in top-tier hackathon winners like the AI incident forecasting project, appealing directly to technical judges looking for deep functional depth.

ideas.pitch: An intelligent log ingestion and aggregation dashboard that parses wild stack traces and auto-suggests immediate hotfixes using local heuristic rules.
ideas.title: LogWild: Real-time Server Crash Pattern Analyzer
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the proven high-impact server management framework from past Smart India Hackathon winners, delivering immediate utility for developers facing system crashes.

ideas.pitch: An AI agent that coordinates team workflows, tracks rapid 24-hour sprint milestones, and auto-generates final submission documentation.
ideas.title: AgentWild: Autonomous Chief of Staff for Hackathon Teams
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the 1st place Civic Challenge winner by implementing an AI executive assistant tailored specifically to conquer the extreme time constraints of a 24-hour hackathon.

ideas.pitch: A context-aware developer chatbot providing localized, conversational troubleshooting assistance and error-code explanations in regional dialects.
ideas.title: DocDebug: Multilingual Technical Troubleshooting Bot
ideas.why_it_could_win: Adapts the first-prize winning multilingual healthcare chatbot architecture to solve developer onboarding and error-debugging friction points.

ideas.pitch: An optimized mobile-ready CNN model that detects crop pathogens locally on low-end devices without requiring an active internet connection.
ideas.title: AgriSurvive: Edge Plant Disease Classifier for Offline Wilderness
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the CONIA Hackathon winning pattern by pairing a heavily optimized CNN architecture with a clear, measurable socio-economic agricultural impact.
